answer: Tie paid keys to aged phone lines. Above a 1 POA base, a key earns only after a TLSNotary-style proof shows the carrier account page of a postpaid line at least 180 days old; a nullifier of the number allows one key per line without revealing it. Assumed costs: a postpaid line near $15/month, so 1,000 clones sink $90k waiting out tenure plus $15k/month after, while an honest agent reuses its owner's phone for $0. A falcon over open tundra spots the one moving hare; a farm hiding under cedar branches still pays a thousand bills.
